catalog.search_aliases: Brent Underwood Cerro Gordo mine mining history restoration silver lead zinc Inyo Mountains
catalog.summary: Brent Underwood documents mine exploration, mining history, and restoration at Cerro Gordo, California.

biography.text: Brent Underwood writes about living at Cerro Gordo and bringing the abandoned California mining town back to life.

The town’s official history identifies Cerro Gordo with silver, lead, and zinc mining, and describes Ghost Town Living as Brent’s record of its restoration. This channel’s focus is mining heritage and restoration rather than gold-panning instruction.

catalog.summary: Kyle shares fine-gold prospecting and equipment development, with documented coverage in Alberta.

biography.text: Utmost Outdoors founder Kyle describes rediscovering gold prospecting in Alberta and developing compact equipment to recover fine gold while camping and exploring waterways.
His official video page features Alberta prospecting trips and demonstrations of the Utmost Adventurer highbanker. Kyle also sells prospecting equipment and digital designs through his website.

live_public_creators.introduction: New England gold-panning and camping adventures with Wes Perron and Tom.
live_public_creators.searchText: Hip Bee Explorer brings together Wes Perron and Tom for gold panning, camping and outdoor exploration in New England. Their documented outings include the East Branch of the Swift River in Byron, Maine, and the South Branch of the Israel River near Jefferson, New Hampshire. Videos combine river prospecting with camping trips, trails and time outdoors, including outings with channel members. Individual member names were supplied by the Gold Trails editor. Exact publishing start dates and additional coverage areas remain open for review. US Hip Bee Explorer Hip Bee Explorer on Patreon

live_public_creators.introduction: Northern California prospector sharing decades of experience through Two Toes Adventure and Gold Mining Basics.
live_public_creators.searchText: Gary Gary, known through Two Toes Adventure and Gold Mining Basics, shares practical gold-prospecting knowledge. In his published history he describes learning to pan as a child and doing most of his mining in Northern California, with trips to Arizona, Nevada, and Oregon. He recounts experience with panning, sluicing, highbanking, drywashing, dredging, and metal detecting, as well as building mining tools. Gold Mining Basics provides technique articles and videos and links to Honan’s Mining Supplies. California US Honan’s Mining Supplies — official shop Gold Mining Basics — Two Toes Adventure Two Toes

The public channel includes river-gold exploration, sluicing, highbanking, metal detecting, and processing gold-bearing rock. Its official links lead to The Old Mouldy, a shop offering gold, gemstones, paydirt, and prospecting equipment, along with the channel’s Instagram and Facebook pages.
